title: Sage, expliCCit's released policy and the rules on net1 v5, on validation links
description: expliCCit reports that its split (net1 and net2) costs about 5% utilization and 9% queueing delay against Sage. Here expliCCit's released policy as deployed (third_party/expliccit-models, imported with the deployed clamping and rounding) runs next to Sage's released policy (release exp-sage-model-24), the fixed rule (u = 0.25) and the share rule (k = 0.5) on net1 v5 (release model-net1v5), and BBRv3, on the five validation families (seed 11) and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s (experiments/copies.py, seed 11): the links and conditions of exp-sage-val-72 (with other episode seeds, since the planner's random stream runs over the controllers). Nothing is chosen here: every candidate was fixed earlier, so this checks the reproduction (expliCCit's own split against Sage in this environment) before the single test. Reported: log utility against BBRv3 per family, the copies' fairness and queueing delay, and utilization and queueing delay against Sage on the conditions where the flow is alone (experiments/sage_report.py).
prepare: SAGE="$IN/sage/sage/sage.onnx"; echo "fc0d6f1da45e4948ee3d96784642793954ed5e52adc1eddd0c9883d5d8fe2f9e  $SAGE" | sha256sum -c; (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run expliccit train import-expliccit third_party/expliccit-models "$OUT/expliccit" --as-deployed; P=(--policy "sage=$SAGE" --policy "expliccit=$OUT/expliccit/policy.onnx" --policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$IN/m/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx"); experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT" && uv run python experiments/sage_report.py "$OUT"
